first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Star-filled night sky
entities.identification: The blue-cyan night sky in the upper part of the image, containing dense points of starlight and a broad pinkish-white to pinkish-purple vertical band of light.

entities.name: Lake surface
entities.identification: The smooth blue water surface in the lower part of the image, with pinkish-purple reflections and bluish-white reflected light in the center-right.

entities.name: Ridge encircling the lake
entities.identification: The dark, undulating line of peaks behind the lakeshore and the mountain walls descending toward the lake surface.

entities.name: Foreground rocky slope
entities.identification: The dark brown to grayish-brown steep slope on the right side and lower-right of the image, with a rough surface and an irregular cliff edge.

entities.name: Evergreen thicket
entities.identification: The cluster of dark, pointed-crown trees along the foreground slope edge, the lower-left image edge, and near the dead tree.

entities.name: Foreground dead tree and dead branches
entities.identification: The slender, leafless dead trunk and side branches extending from the lower edge in the lower-left part of the image, appearing dark gray to grayish-brown in the endpoint frames.
